title: valeriana coreana subsp. sachalinensis
intro: Valeriana coreana subsp. sachalinensis, commonly known as Valerian of Sakhalin, is a subspecies of the Valeriana coreana plant, which belongs to the Valerianaceae family. This perennial herb is native to the Russian Far East and is used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality, due to its numerous health benefits including reducing anxiety and stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Valerian of Sakhalin include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates. The bioactive constituents of Valeriana coreana subsp. sachalinensis have been found to have a sedative effect on the central nervous system, making it a popular natural remedy for insomnia and other sleep disorders.
